I chased on a second channel (SMS) and sent a formal yes/no approval request. I updated the tenant and set a hold with a review date of 17 March.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: It is at the landlord approval gate. The landlord has never replied. The £500+VAT approval noted in event 009 is not backed by landlord words, so it is treated as unapproved. The landlord decision and the tenant photos are still outstanding.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: The landlord has been chased by SMS and sent an approval request. The tenant has been updated by email. The ticket is on hold until 17 March.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. This is a routine job and a second-channel chase has only just gone out. If the landlord is still silent on 17 March, escalate P2 to maintenance.

conflicts: Event 009 says the landlord approved the quote, but later holds say the agency is still waiting for the landlord and no landlord words are on file. I trusted the later holds and treated the job as unapproved.

tickets.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
